summary: Splash Beverage Group filed an 8-K reporting amendments to settlement agreements with three prior investors, extending payment due dates and adding interest, as well as the resignation of two board members and entry into a consulting agreement with one. These are routine debt restructuring and director changes rather than a transformative special situation. The filing lacks any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. No deal terms or premium are involved. The event is a standard current report on material agreements and personnel changes.
